title: Why Directly Learning Periodic Trajectories Can Fail
abstract: arXiv:2609.32254v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Operator learning of periodic solutions requires deciding how simulation data should be recorded and represented. A natural choice is to integrate long enough for transients to decay and record a window wide enough to contain at least one full period of all trajectories. We find that these conservative choices can make the resulting trajectories difficult to learn, even when the underlying periodic orbits vary regularly with system parameters. Unaligned trajectories generalize poorly even within the training distribution. Phase alignment substantially improves in-distribution generalization, but models trained on a fixed physical-time window still have large errors on trajectories with periods outside the training range. We explain both failures through a common mechanism: frequency differences accumulate over time, so the target phase varies rapidly with the parameters. Predictors that cannot track this variation incur a population

translated_title: 为什么直接学习周期轨迹会失败
translated_abstract: 对周期解进行算子学习时，需要决定如何记录和表示仿真数据。一个自然的选择是积分足够长的时间以使瞬态衰减，并记录足够宽的窗口以包含所有轨迹至少一个完整周期。我们发现，这些保守的选择会使所得到的轨迹难以学习，即使底层周期轨道随系统参数规则变化也是如此。未对齐的轨迹即使在训练分布内也泛化不佳。相位对齐能显著改善分布内的泛化能力，但在固定物理时间窗口上训练的模型，对于周期处于训练范围之外的轨迹仍然存在较大误差。我们通过一个共同机制解释了这两种失败：频率差异随时间不断累积，导致目标相位随参数快速变化。无法跟踪这种变化的预测器会产生较大的总体损失。
tldr: 该论文揭示了一个共同机制——频率差异随时间累积使目标相位随参数快速变化——解释了为何直接学习周期轨迹会失败：未对齐轨迹即使在训练分布内也泛化不佳，而固定物理时间窗口训练的模型对训练范围外的周期轨迹误差很大，相位对齐则可显著改善分布内泛化。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies a common mechanism—frequency differences accumulating over time so the target phase varies rapidly with parameters—that explains why directly learning periodic trajectories can fail: unaligned trajectories generalize poorly even in-distribution and models trained on fixed physical-time windows err on out-of-range periods, while phase alignment substantially improves in-distribution generalization.
